- [Subway partners with Adyen to enhance payments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/subway-restaurants-partners-with-adyen-to-advance-its-payment-experience-in-north-america-locations): Subway teams with Adyen to simplify and improve payment experiences across North America in restaurants, online, and via the app.
- [Acne Studios partners with Adyen for seamless payments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/acne-studios-chooses-payments-company-adyen-to-deliver-a-first-class-experience-for-shoppers-globally): Acne Studios uses Adyen's platform to deliver personalized, consistent payment experiences online and in stores worldwide.
- [Adyen Passes $10 Billion Milestone in Payment Transactions Processed](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-passes-10-billion-milestone-in-payment-transactions-processed): Adyen achieved a record growth in 2012 in terms of revenue, transactions processed, mobile payments and new customer wins.
- [Adyen Increases Transaction Volume to $90 Billion in 2016, Nearly Doubling Year-over-Year](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-increases-transaction-volume-to-90-billion-in-2016-nearly-doubling-year-over-year): Leading Payment Platform Continues Push Into Retail Space, Partners With Tory Burch, Burberry and Other Top Retailers
- [H2 2019 financial results and highlights](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/h2-2019-financial-results): Discover Adyen's H2 2019 financial results showing strong growth with €135 billion processed volume and €276 million net revenue.
- [Guzman y Gomez speeds orders and checkout by 30 seconds](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/guzman-y-gomez-speeds-customer-orders-and-checkout-by-30-seconds-with-adyen): Discover how Guzman y Gomez improved order speed and checkout efficiency by 30 seconds with Adyen's seamless payment platform integration.
- [Adyen to publish COVID-19 trading update on April 21](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-to-publish-covid-19-trading-update-on-april-21): Adyen announced a trading update on April 21st for the purpose of providing increased transparency into its underlying business.
- [Adyen reports $727 million revenue in 2016](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-discloses-2016-revenues-of-727-million-growing-99-year-over-year): Adyen's 2016 revenue reached $727 million, nearly doubling year-over-year, with top global clients and seamless payment solutions.
- [FOX+ collaborates with Adyen to offer seamless payment services in Asia, starting with Taiwan and the Philippines](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/fox-collaborates-with-adyen-to-offer-seamless-payment-services-in-asia-starting-with-taiwan-and-the-philippines): The collaboration delivers non-stop access and frictionless credit card transactions for subscribers in both markets
- [Asia’s leading women’s fashion brand - Love, Bonito - expands relationship with Adyen to meet the needs of millennial shoppers in Singapore](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-named-as-a-leader-among-global-merchant-payment-providers): This collaboration delivers frictionless payment transactions to meet the needs of Spendsetters at the newest Love, Bonito store in Singapore
- [Sephora SEA Digital Partners with Adyen to Offer UnionPay SecurePlus to customers](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/sephora-sea-digital-partners-with-adyen-to-offer-unionpay-secureplus-to-customers): Visionary beauty-retailer Sephora SEA Digital’s customers in Hong Kong to become first users of UnionPay SecurePlus globally.
- [Adyen Expands Direct Credit Card Acquiring Capabilities to Include Singapore](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-expands-direct-credit-card-acquiring-capabilities-to-include-singapore): New Service Offering Gives Businesses Rich Data Insights Essential to Overall Customer Experience
- [Adyen rolls out Alipay in stores worldwide](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-rolls-out-alipay-in-stores-worldwide): This expanded partnership enables customers to use Alipay in stores across the globe, during one of the biggest retail events on the Chinese calendar.
- [Adyen for Platforms simplifies payments value chain](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-for-platforms-simplifies-the-payments-value-chain-for-platforms): Adyen for Platforms offers a flexible solution to streamline payments, user sign-up, and payouts for online platforms globally.
- [Showpo selects Adyen to boost global conversions](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/australian-fashion-retailer-showpo-selects-adyen-to-drive-global-customer-conversions): Showpo partners with Adyen to offer seamless payments and expand its global customer base across 80 markets.
- [Aussies hate delivery charges almost as much as queues](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/aussies-hate-delivery-charges-almost-as-much-as-queues): New consumer research shows Aussies are torn between the frustration of standing in line and the cost of paying to have online purchases delivered.
- [Mobile becomes the leader in online shopping by overtaking desktop](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/mobile-becomes-the-leader-in-online-shopping-by-overtaking-desktop): New data from payments platform Adyen reveals 52% of global ecommerce now takes place on mobile devices
- [Air Canada expands alternative payments globally](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/air-canada-expands-acceptance-of-alternative-payments-for-international-transactions-to-support-global-growth-strategy): Air Canada partners with Adyen to offer local payment methods worldwide, enhancing customer experience and supporting global growth.
- [Adyen launches WeChat Pay on Point Of Sale terminals to process payments for 400M Chinese consumers](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-launches-wechat-pay-on-point-of-sale-terminals-to-process-payments-for-400m-chinese-consumers): In time for the holiday shopping season, Adyen now offers China's three largest payment providers on Point of Sale terminals worldwide.
- [Adyen confirms conversion of AGM into a fully virtual meeting](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-confirms-conversion-of-agm-into-a-fully-virtual-meeting): Adyen's annual general meeting of shareholders will be converted into a fully virtual general meeting.
- [Adyen partners with the COVID-19 Solidarity Response Fund to support the World Health Organization](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-partners-with-the-covid-19-solidarity-response-fund-to-support-the-world-health-organization): Adyen’s merchants can now easily collect donations for the fund by accepting donations from their shoppers.
- [All resolutions adopted at Adyen’s AGM](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/all-resolutions-adopted-at-adyens-agm): Adyen announces that its annual general meeting of shareholders approved all resolutions on the agenda.
- [Adyen partners with Michael Hill to help customers continue to celebrate life’s special moments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-partners-with-michael-hill-to-help-customers-continue-to-celebrate-lifes-special-moments): Direct selling and a new payment channel help deliver personalised customer experiences and enable remote work for staff across 300 stores.
- [Pay by Link technology helps Australian boutique keep sales flowing during lockdown](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/pay-by-link-technology-helps-australian-boutique-keep-sales-flowing-during-lockdown): Multi-brand retailer Incu engaged Adyen to roll out new payment channel, with surprising results
- [Adyen announces the addition of payment method Amazon Pay to its single platform](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-announces-the-addition-of-payment-method-amazon-pay-to-its-single-platform): Amazon Pay enables Adyen to provide its merchants’ shoppers with a familiar, fast, and secure way to pay online.
- [Adyen expands acquiring capabilities to Malaysia](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-expands-acquiring-capabilities-to-malaysia): Adyen launches local acquiring in Malaysia to boost authorization rates, enhance customer experience, and support unified commerce for merchants.
- [Adyen to process Zalando's European credit card payments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-to-process-european-credit-card-payments-for-zalando): Adyen expands partnership with Zalando to process credit card payments across Europe, enhancing customer payment experiences and authorization rates.
- [Mobile payments index shows 36% on iPhone](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-mobile-payments-index-reveals-36-of-global-mobile-payments-are-now-on-iphone): The Mobile Payments Index reveals 36% of global mobile payments are made on iPhone, highlighting its growing share and higher transaction values.
- [Adyen to expand into the Middle East, opens Dubai office](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-to-expand-into-the-middle-east-opens-dubai-office)
- [Adyen publishes H1 2020 Financial Results](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-publishes-h1-2020-financial-results): Continued profitable growth despite challenging macroeconomic environment
- [Management board to sell 15% of holdings](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/4-members-of-the-adyen-management-board-to-sell-approximately-15-of-their-holdings): Four Adyen management board members plan to sell about 15% of their shares to diversify portfolios while remaining committed to the company.
- [Adyen Customers Ready for Apple Pay at UK Launch](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-customers-ready-for-apple-pay-at-uk-launch): New payment method an opportunity for UK businesses to connect with affluent demographic
- [Uber expands payments with Adyen in Morocco](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/uber-taps-its-global-payments-partner-adyen-to-expand-into-morocco): Adyen powers Uber's payments in Morocco, enabling local card use and supporting Uber's global growth across 58 countries.
- [Adyen and SAP Commerce integrate payments for retailers](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-teams-up-with-sap-commerce-to-provide-integrated-payments-for-retailers): Adyen's certified integration with SAP Commerce Cloud offers retailers a unified platform for seamless omnichannel payments and business management.
- [SurveyMonkey Taps Adyen for Global Payment Processing, Starting with Brazil](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/surveymonkey-taps-adyen-for-global-payment-processing-starting-with-brazil): More than 800,000 customers in the country will be able to purchase SurveyMonkey’s service in real (R$)
- [Agoda partners with Adyen to improve payment experience for customers](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/agoda-partners-with-adyen-to-improve-payment-experience-for-customers): Partnership enables Agoda to optimize customers’ booking journeys and offer local payment methods
- [Singapore Airlines partners with Adyen to speed digital payment journeys](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/singapore-airlines-partners-with-adyen-to-speed-digital-payment-journeys): Customers can look forward to a more seamless payment experience on the Singapore Airlines website and app
- [SAP Hybris Commerce extension](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/sap-hybris-commerce-extension): Adyen’s new extension for SAP® hybris® Commerce simplifies global commerce for merchants
- [Adyen expands its US retail footprint, announcing RH, Restoration Hardware, as new omnichannel customer](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-expands-its-us-retail-footprint-announcing-rh-restoration-hardware-as-new-omnichannel-customer): Adyen expands its US retail footprint, announcing RH, Restoration Hardware, as new omnichannel customer
- [Adyen selected by Uber as a global 3D Secure solution provider](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-selected-by-uber-as-a-global-3d-secure-solution-provider): Adyen’s 3D Secure solution supports Uber’s seamless checkout experience
- [Adyen expands its global payment offering to Africa](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-expands-its-global-payment-offering-to-africa): Partners with Cellulant, bringing new payment capabilities across Africa, starting with Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana and Uganda.
- [Mobile Share of Local Payment Methods Up to 50 percent, Adyen Reveals](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/mobile-share-of-local-payment-methods-up-to-50-percent-adyen-reveals): Mobile Payments Index uncovers mobile share for key payment methods including Paypal, Alipay and online banking
- [Connected Customers Are Driving Retail’s Transformation](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/connected-customers-are-driving-retails-transformation): Adyen Study Reveals That Unified Commerce Represents a $1.2 Trillion Opportunity in North America
- [Adyen supports Apple Pay for Dutch businesses](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-supports-dutch-businesses-bringing-apple-pay-to-their-customers-in-the-netherlands): Enable Apple Pay with Adyen for fast, secure mobile payments in the Netherlands across online, in-app, and in-store channels.
- [Adyen Achieves Oracle Validated Integration with Oracle Hospitality](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-achieves-oracle-validated-integration-with-oracle-hospitality): Hotels and resorts gain access to global payments platform to better guest experiences
- [Support for Interac Debit via Apple Pay and Google Pay](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-announces-support-for-interac-debit-via-apple-pay-and-google-pay-expands-partnership-with-foodora-canada): Adyen adds Interac Debit support through Apple Pay and Google Pay, expanding its partnership with foodora Canada for seamless payments.
- [Adyen opens office in Sydney](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-opens-office-in-sydney): Adyen, the global payments technology company, today announced the launch of its payments solution in Australia.
- [Postmates Selects Adyen as an Additional Payments Processing Partner](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/postmates-selects-adyen-as-an-additional-payments-processing-partner): Adyen announces that it has been selected by Postmates as a payment provider. Adyen provides support for select Postmates payments across the U.S.
- [Cathay Pacific Selects Adyen for Payment Solution Worldwide](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/cathay-pacific-selects-adyen-for-payment-solution-worldwide): Partnership brings seamless payment experience to passengers from any device and location.
- [Adyen announces 10 new airline customer wins for 2015](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-announces-10-new-airline-customer-wins-for-2015): Payment stability and scalability identified as key differentiators for carriers.
- [Ryanair offers iDEAL payment with Adyen](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/ryanair-offers-the-ideal-payment-experience-with-adyen): Ryanair partners with Adyen to provide iDEAL, enhancing payment options for Dutch customers on Ryanair.com.
- [Adyen enables digital in-store tablet sales](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-enables-the-digital-experience-in-store-with-tablet-assisted-sales): Adyen powers tablet-assisted sales with Commerce Cloud, enhancing in-store digital checkout and personalized shopping experiences globally.
- [Adyen doubles point of sale clients and expands unified commerce](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-doubles-its-point-of-sale-client-list-in-12-months-and-extends-unified-commerce-offer-to-singapore): Adyen expands its point of sale client base and unified commerce offering to Singapore, enhancing in-store and online payment experiences globally.
- [Adyen 2017 revenue crosses $1 billion mark; increase of over $400m from 2016](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-2017-revenue-crosses-1-billion-mark-increase-of-over-400m-from-2016): Leading payments platform bolsters customer wins with eBay, Theory, Tinder, Valve, ofo, giffgaff, Lorna Jane, Groupe L’OCCITANE and ASICS.
- [Adyen partners with Mi9 Retail to offer integrated payments and Point Of Sale solutions](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-partners-with-mi9-retail-to-offer-integrated-payments-and-point-of-sale-solutions): Retail customers will save time and simplify processes behind the scenes.
- [Adyen named to coveted 2018 CNBC Disruptor 50 list](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-named-to-coveted-2018-cnbc-disruptor-50-list): Innovative payments platform recognized as one of the leading private companies transforming the economy and altering its industry.
- [Klook partners with Adyen for seamless payments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/klook-partners-with-adyen-to-offer-seamless-payment-solutions): Klook teams with Adyen to offer travelers seamless payment options with local methods and currencies across Asia Pacific.
- [Adyen first to launch real time Mastercard account updater service globally](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-first-to-launch-real-time-mastercard-account-updater-service-globally): 2.5 Percent of All Card Declines Can be Recovered with No Integration Required.
- [Adyen H1 2018 Financial Results](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-h1-2018-financial-results): Adyen realizes sustained profitable growth at scale in the first half of 2018
- [Adyen launches first-to-market 3D Secure 2.0 solution to help customers boost security and authorisation rates](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-launches-first-to-market-3d-secure-20-solution-to-help-customers-boost-security-and-authorisation-rates): It is the first solution available capable of authenticating a transaction in the background without intervention from the customer.
- [Cotton On Group partners with Adyen to advance global eCommerce rollout](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/cotton-on-group-partners-with-adyen-to-advance-global-ecommerce-rollout): Leading Australian retailer selects Adyen to provide improved online payment capabilities while increasing authorisation rates.
- [Adyen announces intention to list shares on Euronext](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-announces-intention-to-launch-an-offering-and-listing-of-its-shares-on-euronext-amsterdam): Adyen plans to launch an offering and list its shares on Euronext Amsterdam, expanding its global payments platform presence.
- [Adyen IPO priced at €240 per share](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-ipo-priced-at-240-per-share): Adyen's IPO priced at €240 per share with a market cap of €7.1 billion, listing on Euronext Amsterdam starting June 13, 2018.
- [Adyen Study Reveals The Cost Of Convenience; Retailers Lost $37.7B In Potential Sales Due To Long Lines](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-study-reveals-the-cost-of-convenience-retailers-lost-377b-in-potential-sales-due-to-long-lines): US Survey Identifies New, Large Group of Shoppers and Their Affinity for Digital Shopping Tools
- [Gap Inc. Selects Adyen as payments partner](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/gap-inc-selects-adyen-as-payments-partner): Adyen’s unified commerce solution helps Gap Inc. to enhance customer experience online and in-store
- [Adyen expands its unified commerce offering to Canada](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-expands-its-unified-commerce-offering-to-canada): Announces new customers including Dollar Shave Club, Adidas, Busbud and Canada Goose
- [Opportunity for travel industry to go mobile](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-reveals-significant-opportunity-for-travel-industry-to-go-mobile): Discover how the travel industry can boost growth by enhancing mobile payment experiences for airlines and accommodation services.
- [Adyen launches RevenueAccelerate to boost approvals](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-launches-revenueaccelerate): Discover RevenueAccelerate, Adyen's data-driven tools that increase credit card approval rates and unlock new revenue globally.
- [More than a third of global online transactions now mobile](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/more-than-a-third-of-global-online-transactions-now-mobile): For the first time smartphones more popular than tablets for online retail purchases.
- [Adyen processes $50 billion in 2015](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-processes-50-billion-in-2015): Achieves 100% transaction volume growth and more than 100% revenue growth.
- [Grab selects Adyen as payment solution partner for four markets in Southeast Asia](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/grab-selects-adyen-as-payment-solution-partner-for-four-markets-in-southeast-asia): Payments partnership supports Grab in Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam
- [Adyen Global Acquiring expands to Brazil, Hong Kong and Australia](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-global-acquiring-expands-to-brazil-hong-kong-and-australia): Adyen’s modern tech delivers better insights and higher card authorization rates.
- [Etsy partners with Adyen for global payments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/etsy-selects-adyen-for-global-payments): Etsy enhances payments experience worldwide by partnering with Adyen, enabling seamless transactions for millions of buyers and sellers.
- [Adyen and Freelancer.com global payments partnership](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/adyen-and-freelancercom-team-up-for-global-payments-partnership): Adyen partners with Freelancer.com to offer seamless global payments and support local payment methods for a smooth user experience.
- [Althea partners with Adyen for seamless payments](https://www.adyen.com/press-and-media/althea-collaborates-with-adyen-to-offer-customers-in-southeast-asia-a-flawless-payments-experience): Althea teams with Adyen to deliver a smooth, trusted payment experience across Southeast Asia's diverse markets.
